stats.fact: IBM Bob V2 reached general availability on June 24, 2026
Initial GA (V1) was April 28, 2026 as SaaS offering
80,000+ IBM internal developers using Bob, scaled from 100 since June 2025
45% average productivity gain reported across modernization, security, and new development
Bob uses multi-model orchestration: Claude, Mistral open-source, IBM Granite, plus fine-tuned proprietary models
Context window increased from 200K to 270K tokens in V2
Pricing: Free trial (40 Bobcoins), Pro $20/mo (40 Bobcoins), Pro+ $80/mo (160 Bobcoins), Ultra $200/mo (500 Bobcoins)
1 Bobcoin = $0.50 USD; overage billed at same rate
V2 introduced three-tier architecture: Agent (reasoning), Harness (infrastructure), Clients (interfaces)
V2 reduced modes from five to three: Agent, Plan, Ask — with Advanced and Orchestrator capabilities folded in
V2 added background task execution, rollback (replacing checkpoints), and subagent support
Bob offers first-class legacy modernization support for COBOL, JCL, CICS, IMS, RPG, DB2, mainframe

angles: V2's three-tier architecture is a fundamental re-architecture — separating reasoning from infrastructure from interface — making Bob a truly embeddable agent
Three focused modes (Agent/Plan/Ask) reduce complexity vs V1's five modes, making workflow decisions clearer for developers
Background task execution and subagents enable a new class of multi-tasking workflow not available in competing AI coding tools
Rollback replaces git-based checkpoints with direct file state tracking, working per-task/per-turn/per-tool-call — a more granular and reliable approach
Enterprise governance is Bob's key differentiator — no other AI coding tool offers compliance-grade audit trails, built-in security scanning, and human-in-the-loop approval workflows at this level
Bob's legacy modernization support for COBOL, mainframe, and RPG opens a market no AI coding startup addresses
Multi-model orchestration with cost-aware routing is a pragmatic approach to managing AI spend at enterprise scale
